errors.text: The requested critical temperature is not identified; the target places the onset of significant active diffusion and segregation above approximately 673 K.
The proposed heating conditions conflict with the target protocol: 10 K/s and up to 1200 K rather than 1 K/s from 298 to 973 K with measurements at 473, 673, 773, 873, and 973 K.
The cited evidence concerns unrelated HEAs, films, oxidation, corrosion, and creep, and does not directly support AuCoCuNiPt nanoparticle segregation or evaporation.
